_note: What is TRUE, which is not the same as what anybody believes. Three witnesses hold three DIFFERENT facts and none of them holds the case; only putting them together gets you there. That is the shape a dialogue tree cannot represent, because a tree stores answers rather than knowledge.

shot_by._note: Who killed Cortez. functional_in 1: he was killed by one party, so two answers are a contradiction the runtime must surface rather than average.

shot_heard._note: A gunshot at a place and an hour. Halloran has this and nothing else -- he was pouring a drink with his back to the door.

ran_from._note: Somebody leaving somewhere at speed. Vance saw this without seeing a face.

car_waiting._note: A car with its engine running. Okonkwo saw it and did not think about it until later.
